title: His first jobs and the kazoo band
summary: He restates his first orchestra job with Harrison Verrett and Homer Eugene and his first brass-band job with Willie Parker, and the kazoo band.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Who was your very first job with?
Um, with, uh, in orchestra you mean?
Uh, yeah, I think you told me just a minute.
Yeah, with Harrison Verrett Hall, Homer Eugenie and myself. But my first job on the street on a brass band was with Willie Parker. He's the first man brought me on the street.
Yeah, let's see. I wanted to get that kazoo band down there first. You had, what did you call it? Did you call it a kazoo band or what?
Well, I didn't know this is what they used to call it. They said they want to hire a little band for carnival. Uh-huh. In the mid-school, I didn't play with them.
Did any of those guys go on and play music later?
No, I'm the only one. I'm the only one out the bunch that play.
And you were playing bass drum?
Yeah, I was playing bass drum.
